dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: I always make sure to eat a proper meal and get a good night's sleep before an escort job. You gotta make sure you're in top condition for when you hit the road.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Even Man Chai knows that! He always eats a little extra before we set off.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: So, y'know, there's no rush. Let's slow down, drink some tea, then take it from there.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: This place is no joke, man! Those are some hardcore fighters out there!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: But I know you got this. Sure, they might get a lucky shot in here or there, but it's only ever a matter of time before you're wiping the floor with 'em.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Hey, how 'bout you go easy on them next round? It'll gimme a chance to use my kung fu on them.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Okay, you're gonna laugh at me for this, but whatever. Every time I open a book, I doze off in under ten minutes, without fail...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: But Wushou dancing, on the other hand... I can happily practice away all night long, and still be bouncing off the walls in the morning as I get ready to head out for dim sum...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Wait... what if... I were to read a book while performing a Wushou dance? Hohoho, sounds like a plan, right?
